correctness.rationale: Exact Hardy-basis matrix \(n_jb_j/(n_j+k)\) factors as D V*. Separated logarithmic centers admit a quantitative continuous Riesz lower bound via triangular Fourier density, upper Gram-Schur bound, and tail-stable integer sampling. The finite head is recovered from moment uniqueness and injectivity. Surjective V* admits a bounded right inverse, yielding both approximation-number inequalities for every k. The analytic steps apply to all fixed Hadamard gaps; finite rational checks are ancillary.
